questions.stem:
The correct order of energy of the following subshell is
$1s \quad 2s \quad 3p \quad 3d$
questions.solution:
Energy of subshell will depend on $n + l$
$1s$: $n + l = 1 + 0 = 1$
$2s$: $n + l = 2 + 0 = 2$
$3p$: $n + l = 3 + 1 = 4$
$3d$: $n + l = 3 + 2 = 5$
Correct order $\boxed{3d > 3p > 2s > 1s}$

questions.stem:
For an elementary reaction
$\mathrm{A + B \rightarrow C + D}$
When volume becomes $\frac{1}{3}$rd, rate of reaction becomes
questions.solution:
For an elementary reaction
$r = k[A]^{1}[B]^{1}$
When volume becomes $\frac{1}{3}$rd
$[A] \rightarrow 3A$
$[B] \rightarrow 3B$
$r' = k[3A]^{1}[3B]^{1}$
$r' = k\ 3 \times 3\ [A]\ [B]^{1}$
$r' = 9 \times r$
rate of reaction becomes 9 times

questions.stem:
Match the following List-I with List-II.
List-I | List-II
(A) $\mathrm{[CoF_6]^{3-}}$ | (i) $sp^{3}d^{2}$
(B) $\mathrm{[Co(NH)_3)_6]^{3+}}$ | (ii) $d^{2}sp^{3}$
(C) $\mathrm{[NiCl_4]^{2-}}$ | (iii) $sp^{3}$
(D) $\mathrm{[Ni(CN)_4]^{2-}}$ | (iv) $dsp^{2}$
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.solution:
(A) $\mathrm{[CoF_6]^{3-}} \Rightarrow$ Cobalt in $+3$ O.S. with Flourine ligand. Here, $\mathrm{F^{-}}$ act as weak field ligand
$\mathrm{Co^{3+}} \Rightarrow d^{6} \Rightarrow t_{2g}^{4}e_{g}^{2} \Rightarrow e^{-}$ configuration.
$\therefore \mathrm{[CoF_6]^{3-}}$ has hybridisation $\Rightarrow sp^{3}d^{2}$
(B) $\mathrm{[Co(NH_3)_6]^{3+}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{Co^{3+}}$, $\mathrm{NH_3}$ ligand act as SFL.
$\mathrm{Co^{3+}} \Rightarrow d^{6} \Rightarrow t_{2g}^{6}e_{g}^{0} \Rightarrow e^{-}$ configuration.
$\therefore \mathrm{[Co(NH_3)_6]^{3+}} \Rightarrow$ has hybridisation $\Rightarrow d^{2}sp^{3}$
(C) $\mathrm{[NiCl_4]^{2-}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{Ni^{2+}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{Cl^{-}}$ ligand act as WFL.
$\mathrm{Ni^{2+}} \Rightarrow d^{8} \Rightarrow t_{2g}^{6}e_{g}^{2}$ (No pairing by ligand)
$\therefore \mathrm{[NiCl_4]^{2-}}$ has hybridisation $sp^{3}$
(D) $\mathrm{[Ni(CN)_4]^{2-}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{Ni^{2+}} \Rightarrow \mathrm{CN^{-}}$ act as weak field ligand.
$\mathrm{Ni^{2+}} \Rightarrow d^{8} \Rightarrow t_{2g}^{6}e_{g}^{2} \Rightarrow$ (Pairing will occur)
$\mathrm{[Ni(CN)_4]^{2-}}$ has hybridisation $dsp^{2}$

questions.stem: The bacterial life grows as per $1^{st}$ order kinetics. Which of the following graph is correct between $\frac{N}{N_0}$ and t
questions.solution:
$\frac{dN}{dt} = kN$
$\frac{dN}{N} = k\,dt$
On integrating using proper limits
$\int_{N_0}^{N} \frac{dN}{N} = k\int_{0}^{t} dt$
$[\ln N]_{N_0}^{N} = k[t]_{0}^{t}$
$\ln N - \ln N_0 = kt$
$\ln \frac{N}{N_0} = kt$
$\frac{N}{N_0} = e^{kt}$
Value of $\frac{N}{N_0}$ increases exponentially.

questions.stem:
How many of the following molecules are polar?
$\mathrm{CH_4}$, $\mathrm{CCl_4}$, $\mathrm{CH_2Cl_2}$, $\mathrm{H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NH_3}$, $\mathrm{H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{O_2F_2}$
questions.solution:
Compounds having permanent dipole moment ($\mu \neq 0$) are polar
$\mathrm{CH_4}$, $\mathrm{CCl_4} \Rightarrow \mu = 0$
$\mathrm{CH_2Cl_2}$, $\mathrm{H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NH_3}$, $\mathrm{H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{O_2F_2} \Rightarrow \mu \neq 0$
Number of polar molecules = 5

questions.stem: By passing current in 600 mL of NaCl solution pH increases to 12. Find current (i) if electrolysis occur for 10 min(assume 100% efficiency)
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{2H_2O + 2e^{-} \rightarrow 2H_2 + 2OH^{-}}$
$\mathrm{pH} = 12 \quad \mathrm{pOH} = 2 \quad [\mathrm{OH^{-}}] = 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{M}$
g eq. of $\mathrm{OH^{-}}$ formed = no. of faraday of charge passed
$10^{-2} \times \frac{600}{1000} \times 1 = \frac{i \times 10 \times 60}{96500}$
$0.965\ \mathrm{A} = i$
